# CycloneWatch

CycloneWatch is an open-source web app that turns official tropical cyclone
forecasts into transparent 0-100 risk scores for ports, vessels, and any
latitude/longitude on Earth. MIT licensed.

Live site data comes from the NOAA National Hurricane Center (public domain),
refreshed every 10 minutes, and Open-Meteo weather/marine APIs (CC-BY 4.0).
CycloneWatch is an alerting layer, not a forecast model; always follow official
NHC guidance.

## JSON API (no key required)

- GET /api/storms?mode=auto|live|demo
  Returns { mode, storms, updatedAt, source, note }. Each storm includes id,
  name, classification, intensityKt, pressureMb, lat/lon, movement, advisoryTime,
  advisoryUrl, forecast[] ({time, lat, lon, windKt}), cone (polygon),
  windExtents {kt34, kt50, kt64} (polygons), pastTrack, isDemo.
  mode=auto: live data when storms are active, otherwise a labeled demo replay
  of Hurricane Milton (Oct 2024). mode=live: real data only ("none" when quiet).

- GET /api/risk?lat=25.77&lon=-80.17&mode=auto|live|demo
  Returns { point, stormMode, stormsConsidered, risk, conditions, formula, updatedAt }.
  risk = { score 0-100, band (watch|prepare|act), stormId, stormName,
  stormClassLabel, closestDistanceKm, closestWindKt, leadTimeHours, inCone,
  components {proximity, wind, urgency, coneBonus}, closestPoint }.
  conditions = live Open-Meteo data { temperatureC, windKph, weatherLabel,
  waveHeightM }. Returns 400 for invalid coordinates.

- GET /api/health
  Returns { ok, service, version, time, nhcReachable }.

## Risk formula (auditable, shown in the UI)

score = proximity(0-50) + wind(0-30) + urgency(0-20) + coneBonus(0 or 10), capped at 100.
proximity = (1 - distanceKm/600) * 50; reach = max(0, 1 - distanceKm/1200);
wind = (windKt/130) * 30 * reach; urgency = (1 - leadTimeH/120) * 20 * reach;
coneBonus = 10 if inside the forecast cone.
Bands: 0-33 Watch, 34-66 Prepare, 67-100 Act.

## Suggested agent uses

- "What is the cyclone risk for the Port of Houston right now?" -> /api/risk?lat=29.72&lon=-95.08
- "List active storms with forecast tracks" -> /api/storms?mode=live
- "Which of my facilities are in the Act band?" -> call /api/risk per facility, filter score >= 67
